scope: protocol, custody, stack parsing, allocation-counter reconciliation, and source-attribution review; no formal population capture, latency measurement, build, or production edit by this review

stack_semantics.record_scope: whole debuggee process, including corpus/oracle setup, all 20 full-cell iterations, report/producer serialization, process setup, and post-endpoint worksheet tolerance guards
stack_semantics.timed_workload_scope: fresh SourceBackedWorkbook open, worksheet enumeration, Rect::ALL stored-cell visits, and callback canonical digest; the heaptrack profile is not a timer and must not be presented as a latency result
print_options: -p 0 and -a 1 for bounded ranked text; ranked-text truncation does not truncate -F/-H
stack_semantics.flamegraph_order: root-to-leaf; nearest owner is the rightmost recognized frame
stack_semantics.disjoint_assignment: each stack allocation cost belongs to exactly one nearest recognized owner bucket; owner buckets are legacycodec, mce_stream, selected_worksheet, x14ac, and other
stack_semantics.inclusive_assignment: a separate diagnostic count adds a stack once to each owner category present; inclusive values overlap and are never summed into disjoint totals
stack_semantics.source_attribution: stack-presence regions only; scan-closure and forced-worksheet-guard frames are disjoint labels, with no temporal segmentation or timer claim

reconciliation_contract.stack_total: sum of positive decimal costs in every nonempty flamegraph stack line after removing exactly one terminal separator
reconciliation_contract.printed_total: last `calls to allocation functions` total in heaptrack_print ranked text
reconciliation_contract.histogram_total: sum of positive allocation counts in every histogram row
reconciliation_contract.required_equality: stack_total == printed_total == histogram_total for every profile
reconciliation_contract.counter_semantics: heaptrack allocation-hook calls; not a count of all process memory activity, and not a latency metric
reconciliation_contract.malformed_input: reject non-decimal, zero, negative, empty, or interior-empty stack/histogram fields
reconciliation_contract.symbol_quality: retain unresolved/unclassified frames and review their allocation share; unresolved symbols do not establish causal ownership

guard_contract.name: post-endpoint-per-worksheet-tolerance-v1
required_per_profile: aggregate tolerance report clean after worksheet reports
final source-version fence after the aggregate report
typed errors and callback ordering preserved by the sealed 0894 validator

preflight.scope: one candidate-native warm-cache scan with zero warmups, retained only for symbol and parser qualification
preflight.semantic_result: preflight report passed the sealed producer oracle and four-worksheet tolerance guard

findings_resolved: Heaptrack 1.5.0 emits zstd traces; the frozen profile suffix and capture artifact are `.zst`.
The 0895 plan seals all packet helpers, including capture, export, reduction, verification, and source attribution, plus the exact heaptrack, heaptrack_print, and taskset identities.
The flamegraph parser accepts heaptrack_print's one terminal semicolon while rejecting empty interior frames.
The nearest-owner direction is fixed to the rightmost frame because heaptrack flamegraph stacks are root-to-leaf; inclusive counts are retained separately.
The exact 0894 guard reference and producer validator are inherited through the frozen base plan and checked before formal capture.
negative_controls: Changed 0894 binary, base-plan, tool, packet-helper, or reused-helper bytes fail descriptor binding.
Changed CPU, cache state, role order, sample count, guard contract, profile suffix, owner categories, or print argv fails plan loading.
A nonzero child, missing profile, missing sidecar, report/oracle mismatch, guard-vector mismatch, or reordered child stops capture without retry or replacement.
A malformed stack or histogram line, mismatched printed/stack/histogram total, or changed export artifact fails reduction.
The independent verifier launches no workload or profiler command and replays command, binary, plan, semantic, guard, artifact, and reduction identities.
caveats: Only two whole-process traces per role are planned; this is descriptive allocation evidence with no uncertainty interval or adoption gate.

Heaptrack instrumentation and its wrapper can affect process behavior; identical pinned tool versions and role order make the profile a scoped mechanism comparison, not an uninstrumented allocation count.
Whole-process totals intentionally include setup, oracle construction, output serialization, and post-endpoint guards; stack presence cannot assign allocations to a time interval.
CPU affinity is recorded without an exclusive-host guarantee and the filesystem cache is warm; no cold-cache, native Office, or universal producer claim follows.
Nested inclusive owner counts overlap and must not be added; source-audit line attribution is a bounded hypothesis aid, not proof of causality or a production performance claim.
